name: Elise Mertens
intro: Elise Mertens is a tennis star from Belgium. She has won ten singles titles. In doubles she has been the number one player in the whole world.
story: Elise's big sister Lauren put a racket in her hand at age four. Lauren is now an airline pilot! Later Elise trained at the tennis school of Belgian champ Kim Clijsters. Last summer she won a title after saving eleven match points. That means she was one point from losing eleven times, and still won!

funFacts.text: She has a house full of rescue dogs. She wants to be a voice for shelter animals.
Her family keeps birds too: peacocks, pheasants, chickens, and cranes.
She speaks three languages: Dutch, French, and English.
She was homeschooled so she could travel and play tennis.
Her dad makes furniture for churches. Her mom is a teacher.
She has won six doubles titles at Grand Slams, the four biggest tournaments.
She has a tiny green tattoo on her wrist for her dog Bo. Green means hope.

watchFor: Watch how fast she runs to the net to smack a volley. Doubles champs love the net!
